title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 12: Nathan's parable, David's confession, the death of the child, and the birth of Solomon.

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh send to David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:1 says Yahweh sent Nathan to David.

questions.text: In Nathan's story, what did the poor man have?
questions.explanation: The poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and raised.

questions.text: How did David say the rich man must restore the lamb?
questions.explanation: David said, "He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity!"

questions.text: What did Nathan say to David after David judged the rich man?
questions.explanation: Nathan said to David, "You are the man."

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would never depart from David's house?
questions.explanation: Nathan said, "Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house."

questions.text: What did David say to Nathan after hearing Yahweh's word?
questions.explanation: David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against Yahweh."

answers.text: "I am the king; who can judge me?"

questions.text: On which day did the child die?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day, the child died.

questions.text: What did David say about his dead child?
questions.explanation: David said, "I will go to him, but he will not return to me."

answers.text: "I will go to him, but he will not return to me."
"I will fast until he lives again."

questions.text: What name was Solomon given through Nathan the prophet?
questions.explanation: He sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh's sake.

questions.text: What was the weight of the crown David took from the king of Rabbah?
questions.explanation: He took the crown of their king from off his head; its weight was a talent of gold, with precious stones in it.
